snippet.title: Trash Goblin - Accessibility Update Trailer - Access-Ability Summer Showcase 2025
snippet.description: A wholesome, cosy shopkeeping game with no time pressure! Uncover & clean trinkets then upcycle them to sell to endless colourful & quirky customers. Spend your savings to upgrade your shop, buy better tools, plus expand and customise your space.
